rule: missing GUI instrumentation is recorded as unavailable, never simulated (charter WSP1L.3)

reasons: the WSP1L instrumented client build (Lapce v0.4.6 + packages/dx-harness/lapce/instrumented-client/lapce-0.4.6-wsp1l.patch) was driven on the local interactive windows machine through the WSP1L drive channel with the production volt and the native verter-lsp server

the capture recorded client-observed UI stage stamps (input_dispatched/decoded/applied/painted) for open/type/complete/navigate/close and the server interaction-trace dump anchored to the Unix clock (WSP1L.2 correlation)
the recorded artifact is digest-sealed (driven-lapce-capture.v1) and the lapce-client pin names exactly that build; relabeled fixtures and hand-written capture lines stay inadmissible
whatIsProvenHermetically: a deliberately stalled UI thread is detected while the server timeline shows immediate completion, and the first blocked stage is named (WSP1L-AC1; packages/dx-harness/test/lapceDriver.test.ts)
two runs of the same scripted interaction compare within a recorded noise bound, and unknowns never become zeros (WSP1L-AC2)
the driver refuses to certify a run whose protocol smoke passed with no UI timeline (WSP1L-AC3)

the volt writes a one-time initialize launch-stamp line to host stderr behind uiTrace.enabled (default off, no UI notification) and dx-harness parses `verter launch-stamp`/`verter ui-stamp` lines both raw and embedded as host-log trailing fields (the real client's tracing rendering), joining their Unix-ms clock to the timeline clock only through a capture-recorded anchor (WSP1L.1/WSP1L.2)

RealLapceHost constructs only from a provenance-complete capture (pinned lapce-client, issued launch stamp, UI observations, clock anchor) and fails closed otherwise; fixture timestamps relabeled with the real hostKind are refused as real-client claims

the recorded real-client capture replays through RealLapceHost with digest-verified provenance and certifies real-client evidence; dual-relabeled fixture runs, hand-written capture lines and copied provenance are refused by the same gates (packages/dx-harness/test/lapceDriver.test.ts)

automationPathRecorded.fixture: instrumented-fixture-host: deterministic scripted UI event emission; no GUI, no sleeps, no real Lapce process
automationPathRecorded.realHost: instrumented-client-build + volt launch-stamp + wsp1l drive channel: the reference Lapce build (WSP1L instrumentation patch) drives open/type/complete/navigate/close on its UI event loop over the external drive channel (inactive without VERTER_WSP1L_DRIVE_ADDR) and emits `verter ui-stamp` stage observations at the real pipeline seams; the volt emits its one-time initialize launch-stamp behind uiTrace.enabled; per-message LSP path untouched

stillUnavailable: the recorded capture is a single local interactive machine session (windows-x64), not a manifested reference-client machine: reference-machine-manifests.v1 population is still empty, so cross-machine comparability and Issue 93 reproduction claims stay unavailable
WSP1L-AC2 comparability of the real client needs a second recorded run of the same script on the same recorded basis; only one capture is committed
